name: NX Android Streamer
tagline: Your PC is the phone, your phone is the glass — stream a full Android that feels native

artifacts.label: Server rig (Linux)
artifacts.postInstallNote: One-time setup needs root and downloads ~1 GB, so it runs in a terminal window: press Run and follow it (setup → ARM apps → network/adb repair). After that, Launch boots the Android session AND starts streaming — the card shows live status while it runs, and Stop shuts it down.
